description: Hand-written questions about 'AI-Driven Software Testing & QA Transformation Program' (the syllabus PDF). Every answerable question has an evidence_phrase that is checked against the extracted text of expected_pages, so labels cannot silently drift. Unanswerable questions ask about things the syllabus does not contain.

answerable.question: Who is the target audience for this program?
What are the prerequisites for the course?
Which prompt patterns for QA are taught, such as negative testing and boundary value analysis?
What is chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting?
What are the limitations and risks of using AI in QA, like hallucination and bias?
What does the Jira for QA section cover about bug lifecycle?
How is Zephyr used for test management and traceability?
How is AI used to generate test data, including valid and invalid and boundary data?
What is an RTM traceability matrix and how does AI help generate it?
What does the governance framework include, such as logging and audit practices?
What is self-healing automation and how does it handle locator changes?
How is API test generation from Swagger and visual comparison covered?
How is time saved calculated when comparing manual work with AI?
What are the final deliverables of the capstone project?
What does the trainer need to set up for the AI test automation module with Selenium and Playwright?
What is the total duration of the whole program in hours?

unanswerable: What is the fee or price of this program?
